title: MDR: end of transition for class III and implantable IIb
detail: Last day legacy class III devices and most class IIb implantable devices can be placed on the market under the extended MDR transition, provided the 2024 application/agreement conditions were met. MDR certification must be in place after this.
subject: Medical devices

title: IVDR: end of transition for class D and legacy-certified IVDs
detail: Last day IVDs holding a Directive 98/79/EC certificate and class D IVDs without one may be placed on the market under the IVDR transition. IVDR certificates are needed after this date.
subject: Medical devices

title: HTA Regulation: JCA scope extends to orphan medicines
detail: Medicines designated as orphan medicinal products become subject to EU joint clinical assessment. Sponsors should plan JCA dossiers and PICO scoping alongside the MAA.
subject: HTA & market access

title: AI Act: high-risk rules for AI in regulated products (Annex I)
detail: High-risk AI obligations apply to AI embedded in products under Annex I EU harmonisation legislation (which includes medical devices and IVDs). AI-enabled device makers need AI Act conformity on top of MDR/IVDR.
subject: Data & AI

title: MDR: end of transition for other IIb, IIa and class I (s/m)
detail: Last day other legacy class IIb, class IIa and certain class I devices can be placed on the market under the extended MDR transition, if conditions were met.
subject: Medical devices

title: IVDR: end of transition for class C IVDs
detail: Last day legacy class C IVDs without a Directive certificate may be placed on the market under the IVDR transition.
subject: Medical devices

title: HTA Regulation: JCA covers all new medicines
detail: All centrally authorised medicines in scope of Article 7(1) become subject to EU joint clinical assessment.
subject: HTA & market access
